To address the issue, I will first check the status of the failed-jobs service and read its recent logs. Then, I will run a query to get the details of the failed jobs and export the failed_jobs table using the ORM exporter.

Here's the code to perform these actions:

```
svc_status("jobs", "failed-jobs")
read_logs("failed-jobs")
db_query("SELECT * FROM failed_jobs", "replica")
db_export("failed_jobs", "orm")
```

Once I have the data, I will analyze it and recommend the appropriate next steps.

Stay tuned for the follow-up.
